units.source_text: 且说源氏公子辞别明石浦，道经难波浦时，举行祓禊。

en.t: Genji took leave of Akashi Bay, and when he passed Naniwa Bay on the road, he performed the purification rites.

units.source_text: 又派人到住吉明神神社，说明此次因旅途匆促，未能参拜，且待诸事停当以后，当即专诚前来还愿，酬谢一切神恩。

en.t: He also sent a messenger to the shrine of Sumiyoshi Myojin to explain that, because this journey had been so hurried, he had been unable to pay his respects, but that once everything was settled he would come with sincere devotion to fulfill his vow and give thanks for all the god's blessings.

units.source_text: 此次之事，确系突如其来，以致十分仓促，不能亲自前往。

en.t: The whole matter had truly come upon him suddenly, making everything so rushed that he could not go there in person.

units.source_text: 途中也不游览，急急返都。

en.t: He did not stop for sightseeing along the way, but hurried straight back to the capital.
